title: CAPBALL — bottle-cap street football
description: Flick bottle caps into a ball, bang it off the boards and score in the car park. Two-player pass-and-play with quick matches, penalty shootouts and a street tournament. Works offline.

defaultCaptions.x: Flicked a bottle cap off the boards and into the top bin. CAPBALL — street football for two thumbs.
defaultCaptions.facebook: CAPBALL: bottle-cap street football. Flick your caps, chain passes for a power shot, and settle it on penalties.
defaultCaptions.reddit: I made a physics bottle-cap football game: caps slide, collide and settle for real, and the boards count as a teammate.
defaultCaptions.discord: CAPBALL night? Pass-and-play bottle-cap football: quick match, penalty shootout or a 4-crew tournament.
